sentences.en: The boat was brought up from the seabed by the Algerian authorities.
sentences.zh: 这艘船被阿尔及利亚当局从海底打捞上来。

sentences.en: Diverse life forms live on the seabed.
sentences.zh: 各种生命形式生活在海床上。

sentences.en: Scientists are studying the effects of climate change on the ocean's seabed.
sentences.zh: 科学家正在研究气候变化对海洋海底的影响。
